# Wexpro Labs

Wexpro Labs builds workflow automation, inference systems, long-running agent infrastructure, and local tools that make existing AI agents cheaper and more reliable.

## Pages

- [Wexpro Labs overview](/): current lab focus.
- [Workflow Automation](/workflow-automation/): recorded workflow helpers for repeated computer work. The first step is recording one task so Wexpro Labs can learn the steps, variables, checks, and review points, then turn it into a helper that can run again. LLM summary: [/workflow-automation/llms.txt](/workflow-automation/llms.txt).
- [Context Compression](/context-compression/): local verifier for AI agents that read JSON, JSONL, CSV, and TSV; it returns lower-token sidecars only after round-trip checks pass, leaves source files untouched, and falls back to raw when unsafe.
